thread:
maria_csm: Quick heads-up — Sirio Health is going live with an APAC pilot tomorrow 08:00 SGT. They asked for a temporary allowlist + rate bump on the SG edge for 48h.

maria_csm: Request details from the customer: IPs -> 203.56.112.45/32, 203.56.112.46/32. Desired QPS: 10 steady, short bursts up to 30 for 5m windows. Start: 2026-03-22T08:00:00+08:00. Duration: 48h.

ryan_netops: Got it. Do we need an egress peering change or just firewall allowlist + RL config?

maria_csm: They said the traffic will come from corporate egress (not our peering). So just IP allowlist on load balancer + per-customer rate policy tweak on SG-edge route.

kevin_eng: Can you paste the exact route name and org id? I’ll prepare the policy.

maria_csm: org_id: srv-0123, route: /v1/sirio-api (hosted on redwood-sg-edge-1). I told them to keep content size small during pilot.

ryan_netops: Creating infra ticket and scheduling window. tagging @infra-bot to provision allowlist.

infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-2026 created: "Allowlist & temporary rate increase for srv-0123 (Sirio Health) on SG edge". Owner: @ryan_netops. ETA: 2h for LB rule, immediate for policy rollout when ready.

sara_cs: Noted. I’ll confirm invoicing implications with billing (temporary bump might incur overage). Also asking the customer for a rollback contact.

kevin_eng: Drafting rate policy. Proposed patch:
```yaml
customer_id: "srv-0123"
route: "/v1/sirio-api"
edge_region: "sg"
policy: 
  baseline_qps: 10
  burst_limit: 30
  window: 300 # seconds
  expires_at: "2026-03-24T08:00:00+08:00"
allowlist:
  - "203.56.112.45/32"
  - "203.56.112.46/32"
notes: "Temporary pilot; auto-revoke after expiry. Contact: sara_cs@redwood.com"
```

kevin_eng: I'll roll this to canary on sg-edge-1 (10% traffic) then promote.

ryan_netops: LB rules applied (INFRA-2026). Please validate from customer IPs.

maria_csm: Pinging Sirio to test. They report timed out earlier — will try again in 5.

sirio-test (external): curl from 203.56.112.45 -> connection OK, HTTP 200, body: {"status":"ok"} ; observed header x-edge-region: sg

kevin_eng: Canary rollout done. Promoting to 100% for sg-edge-1.

infra-bot: Policy deployment success: policy-id pol-7893 applied to sg-edge-1.

maria_csm: Customer confirms they can hit endpoints and saw improved 95th latency from ~320ms -> ~110ms after region steering. They love it :tada:

sara_cs: Great. I've noted the overage flag and set a reminder to review usage on 2026-03-23. Will request explicit renewal signal after pilot.

kevin_eng: Leaving the auto-revoke in place. If they ask to extend, we need escalation per account ops process.

ryan_netops: Logging operational note: temporary RL increase for srv-0123; revoke check scheduled at 2026-03-24T08:10+08:00.

maria_csm: Thanks team. Capturing customer feedback: lower latency in SG, want APAC docs for peering checklist. Action: kevin -> add short howto in onboarding playbook; sara -> confirm billing terms; ryan -> confirm revoke automation.

kevin_eng: Will add a 1-paragraph howto and sample policy to onboarding repo by EOD.

infra-bot: INFRA-2026 marked resolved (allowlist applied, policy active, auto-revoke scheduled).

sara_cs: Closing loop with customer now.

maria_csm: Closing thread — thanks everyone :rocket:
